sender.bs: Nepoznat muškarac na Viberu ili WhatsAppu koji se predstavlja kao „opasan“ čovjek iz Sarajeva
sender.en: An unknown man on Viber or WhatsApp presenting himself as a “dangerous” man from Sarajevo

name.bs: „Dužni ste eskort dami“: prijetnje i traženje xBon bonova
name.en: “You owe an escort”: threats and demands for xBon vouchers

how.bs: S različitih brojeva stižu poruke i pozivi: neko je navodno vašim slikama i podacima napravio dug kod „njegove“ eskort dame. Da biste „dokazali da niste krivi“, morate kupiti xBon bonove i poslati slike kodova. Zahtjeve prate prijetnje vama i porodici. Uplaćeni bonovi su izgubljen novac.
how.en: Messages and calls come from different numbers: someone supposedly used your photos and details to run up a debt with “his” escort. To “prove you are innocent” you must buy xBon vouchers and send photos of the codes. The demands come with threats against you and your family. The vouchers paid for are lost money.

text.bs: Poruka ili poziv s nepoznatog broja: „dužni ste“.
text.en: A message or call from an unknown number: “you owe money”.
Threats against you and your family.

text.bs: Kupite xBon bonove i pošaljite slike kodova.
text.en: Buy xBon vouchers and send photos of the codes.

text.bs: Slušaj me dobro. Neko se s tvojim slikama dogovorio sa mojom djevojkom i nije platio. Ako nisi ti, dokaži: kupi bonove od 100 KM i pošalji mi slike kodova do večeras. Ako ne, znam gdje živiš i dolazim. Nikome ni riječi.
text.en: Listen to me carefully. Someone used your photos to make a deal with my girl and didn’t pay. If it wasn’t you, prove it: buy 100 KM in vouchers and send me photos of the codes by tonight. If not, I know where you live and I’m coming. Not a word to anyone.

bs: Nepoznata osoba tvrdi da dugujete nešto za šta nikad niste čuli.
Prijetnje i poruke s više različitih brojeva.
en: A stranger claims you owe for something you’ve never heard of.
Payment by vouchers and photos of codes.
Threats and messages from several different numbers.

bs: Ne plaćajte i ne šaljite kodove; prekinite poziv i blokirajte brojeve.
Prijavite prijetnje najbližoj policijskoj stanici ili na 122.
en: Don’t pay or send codes; hang up and block the numbers.
Report the threats to the nearest police station or on 122.
